svg.title: Benchline on Kubernetes, with MinIO and a Go lag monitor
svg.desc: A kind cluster runs the chart: a migration job, five services with startup, readiness and liveness probes, and a helm test. Raw CMS files go to MinIO through the S3 API. A Go service reports how far each Kafka consumer is behind.
svg.text: the same chart on a laptop (kind) and in CI, on every push
every pod: startup, ready and live probes
then helm test calls each one and reads the lag
zero means caught up. a number that keeps rising means a stuck worker.
